payload.title: Approved main revisions deploy through short-lived GitHub identity
payload.description:
As the maintainer, I want a validated `main` revision to deploy to production through GitHub OIDC, so that routine coding work never depends on a personal AWS login.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Production delivery from main

  Scenario: A validated main revision is deployed with a short-lived identity
    Given a trusted push of revision SHA to the main branch
    And the required CI checks for that revision have succeeded
    When the production delivery workflow runs
    Then it assumes only the repository-scoped GitHub OIDC deploy role
    And it deploys that exact revision to the Sierrendipity stack
    And it records the branch, SHA, workflow run, and live verification result

  Scenario: Untrusted pull-request code cannot deploy production
    Given a pull request from any branch or fork
    When CI runs for that pull request
    Then no production deployment job runs
    And no AWS deployment credentials are requested
```

Implementation is split between the workflow task SIE-1bb857 and the existing OIDC role task SIE-f0d77c.
